Jia: quick ping — PR #2598 needs a tiny follow-up before I can merge. Linter flagged an initialism and import order. CI otherwise green. Would someone take a look? plan is to merge before the 09:00 UTC deploy window.
Devon: looking now. do you have the exact failing message?
Jia: yep: `internal/user/user.go:42:2: var userId should be userID (golint)`
Jia: offending line:
```
func setUserId(u *User) error {
    // ...
}
```
Alex: easy fix — rename symbol to `setUserID`. also linter wants import block grouped standard | external | internal. run `gofmt` + `goimports` then push.
Maria: also add a quick unit test update if the function is referenced by name in tests. otherwise fine.
Jia: ok i'll patch and force-push. will run `golangci-lint run --fix` then `goimports -w`.
ci-bot: golangci-lint report: 1 error -> initialism "userId" at internal/user/user.go:42
Devon: once you push ping me and I'll approve. can we avoid renaming exported identifiers? is `setUserId` exported? (lowercase -> unexported)
Jia: it's unexported, safe to rename.
Jia: pushed fix and ran goimports. CL: `setUserID` + import reorder. PTAL
Devon: LGTM :+1: approving now.
merge-bot: merge-queue: PR #2598 passed checks; scheduling merge in 5s.
merge-bot: PR #2598 merged into main by merge-bot :shipit: 
Alex: thanks — good catch. closing the loop.
Maria: :tada: great that was quick.
